description: World nodes ArchiveXL deletes from their streaming sectors, for objects the owner's rules remove that no variant toggle hides (docs/design/venue-node-policy.md section 5; owner 2026-11-27: world edits only where genuinely needed). Each node is named by a stable identity, not an index: tools/world-deletions.py resolves the index from a fresh conversion of the sector, checks the type and template, and writes the nodeDeletions block into src/archive/pc/mod/neon_ascendancy_world.archive.xl.
